summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing an announcement to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange giving notice of a board meeting. The board will meet to discuss and approve unaudited results for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, with the results announcement scheduled for November 19, 2026. No terms, transactions, or structural changes are disclosed. The filing notes the weighted voting rights structure from the Alibaba Partnership's director nomination rights and confirms the ADS listing on the NYSE. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice; no special-situation angle or arbitrage consideration applies.
